paragraphs: Nash (נש). Abba Shaul bar Nash (אבא שאול בר נש), [Niddah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.25b.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: נש is retained as Nash; this notice does not settle whether it is a personal name or the Aramaic word for a person.
The linked baraita gives Abba Shaul bar Nash and an alternative, Abba Shaul bar Remash. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3262&lang=en) also records both readings.
